scope: Local experimental training range; native Studio client with temporary injected review LocalScript in ignored alternate build

implementation.charge: tap to full; sampled per shot
implementation.flip: accepted BlasterMotion Toss.Draw track after 0.06-second shot launch; same interpolation and catch/rebound
implementation.first_person: gun transform applied directly to visible copy after smoothing; hidden source tool recoil suppressed to prevent double application
implementation.third_person: native grip cosmetic transform plus bounded arm follow
implementation.network: shot request selects cosmetic enum; server allowlists Kick/Flip in accepted Shot event
implementation.lifecycle: holster clears recoil start; setting changes apply on next shot

runtime.sample_checks: both styles and charges 0/1: bounded finite translation and identity after one second
runtime.reequip: visual rig present after UnequipTools/EquipTool cycle
runtime.cleanup: review session closed; normal target range reopened; lobby window retained

limits: One local client near 17 rendered frames per second during sampling.
No measured moving/tap trial, other-client playback or high-frame-rate visual review.
Settings selection in probe used the same local attribute; no automated pointer/button usability verdict.
Sample endpoint checks do not prove every visual catch frame.
